description.value: Cottonwood House Historic Park is a BC Parks-managed heritage property in the Cariboo region of British Columbia, tagged in OSM as a nature reserve. The park is situated near coordinates 53.05°N, 122.16°W in a region traversed by touring cyclists on longer interior routes.
